title: Gateway pipeline: maxConnections -1, 0 and 100000 are accepted, and the update COMPLETES

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard gateway, one run per value

symptom: pipelines.gateway.realtime.maxConnections of -1, 0 and 100000: the create and the update succeeded, with all 10 rows. snapshot.maxConnections of 0 was also accepted. No error.
cause: Not established. The code reading found no range check for these settings.
effect: A bad value reaches the connection pool with no message, and its effect wasn't measured.
fix: Set a positive integer you've sized for the source's connection limit.
notes: One run per value. The gateway log wasn't read, so the value's effect on the pool isn't confirmed.
